findings.location: Search results, no matches - first message, "Input on resubmission: not-applicable"
findings.violation: If the error fires as a result of the user's submit action, they would naturally want to resubmit; marking input disposition as "not-applicable" contradicts this recovery pattern.
A notification about changed sync status should fire when the status changes to paused, not when the notification center receives focus; this would delay the user learning about the pause.
